description: This Java class 'PersistableProductReview' extends 'ProductReviewEntity' and adds a 'customerId' property with getter and setter methods. It implements Serializable and uses Java validation annotations.

classes.name: PersistableProductReview
classes.description: A Java class representing a persistable product review with an associated customer ID, extending ProductReviewEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the product review.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID associated with the product review.
